Record Class TradingAccountRecord

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
app.record.TradingAccountRecord
Record Components:
accountId - the account
userId - the trader who owns it
name - the account's display name
openedDate - the day it was opened
currency - the account's currency code
status - ACTIVE or ARCHIVED
archivedAt - archive timestamp, otherwise null
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlatformRecord
public record TradingAccountRecord(Integer accountId, UUID userId, String name, LocalDate openedDate, String currency, String status, Instant archivedAt) extends Record implements PlatformRecord
A trading account, published as "TRADING_ACCOUNT" when it is opened or renamed or archived. It is what ties an account id, the key of every order event, to its owner.
